run_text_generation_gpt2: run conditional text generation with a GPT-2 model from a command-line prompt
run_text_generation_ctrl: run conditional text generation with a CTRL model using control codes for guided output
run_text_generation_xlnet: run conditional text generation with XLNet using padding text for short prompts
run_text_generation_from_file: run text generation on multiple prompts read from a file and save results to output path
run_text_generation_configurable: run text generation with configurable temperature, top-k, top-p, and repetition penalty
